content: मघः .²1 <ab>N.</ab> of one of the Dvīpas or divisions of the universe. .²2 <ab>N.</ab> of a country. .²3 A kind of drug or medicine. .²4 Pleasure. .²5 <ab>N.</ab> of the tenth lunar mansion; see मघा. .²6 See मघम्. .{@-घम्@} .²1 A kind of flower. .²2 A gift, present. .²3 Wealth, riches (<ab>Ved.</ab>).
